items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 12 at 3:56AM AKDT until August 13 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the low to mid 80s expected, particularly
away from the water.

* WHERE...Haines Borough and Klukwan and Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From noon today to 7 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Municipality of Skagway; Haines Borough and Klukwan
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Close curtains during the daytime to reduce sun insulation into the
home and open windows at night to allow the home to cool off. Utilize
fans or community buildings with air conditioning.

items.headline: Flood Warning issued August 12 at 12:57AM AKDT until August 14 at 4:30AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Mendenhall Lake gauge levels, along with USGS imagery from Suicide
Basin and water levels within the basin, indicate that the basin is
continuing its release of water into Mendenhall Lake and River.
Levels on the Mendenhall Lake and River will rise through Wednesday
as the release continues, with a forecast crest between 16.1 to 16.6
feet expected early Thursday morning.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 11 at 2:42PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The warmest stretch of weather so far this summer is expected from
Wednesday through the weekend. High temperatures warming into the
upper 70s or lower 80s each day with lows dipping into the 50s are
expected. Areas of wildfire smoke across the middle Tanana Valley
are already reducing air quality. Light winds are unlikely to
clear out the smoke.

Drinking plenty of fluids, avoiding strenuous outdoor activity,
and limiting exposure to smoke is recommended.
